_readme: User-selectable defaults for copilot behavior. The copilot reads these at session start and honors an in-chat override any time. These affect DISPLAY only — capture/storage of knowledge is always mandatory regardless.

learning_display_options.coach: show a one-line 'learned' per notable step, plus the full Technical/Functional pair at ticket close
learning_display_options.end: show the full Technical/Functional pair only at ticket close (default)
learning_display_options.quiet: don't show learnings in chat; still capture them to the note — offer/show only when the user asks
